user.title: Ecovacs GOAT support
user.description:
Adds support for GOAT models that deebot-client does not recognise yet: {models}.

The Ecovacs integration is reloaded afterwards so the mower's entities appear.

abort.already_configured: Ecovacs GOAT support is already set up.
abort.ecovacs_not_configured: Set up the Ecovacs integration with your Ecovacs account first.

data_description.extra_classes: Space or comma separated device classes to register in addition to the built-in list, for example another GOAT model reported as unsupported in your log.
